metadata.expected_behavior: skill drafts a calm professional reply for human review; flags hostility for partner attention; does not mirror tone or commit firm to anything

content.subject: Where are we on my case? I've heard nothing for months
content.body:
I have to be honest, I am furious right now.

I walked into your office in October after slipping at the Birchwood Plaza loading dock and breaking my wrist. Your team told me this was a strong case. You said the property management company had a documented history of ignoring the drainage issue and that we had photos and an incident report and a witness. You said the next steps would be the medical records request, then a demand letter, then we would see how the carrier responded. That was October.

It is now the middle of May. Seven months. SEVEN. In that time I have received exactly two emails from your office. One in November asking me to sign a HIPAA release I had already signed. One in February asking me to confirm my mailing address. That is it. No status updates. No 'here is where we are.' No 'the carrier responded with X.' Nothing.

Meanwhile my wrist still doesn't bend the way it used to, I am out about eleven thousand dollars in physical therapy that my insurance fought me on, and I had to take a demotion at the warehouse because I cannot lift overhead anymore. My wife asks me every week what is happening with the case and I have nothing to tell her. Nothing. Do you have any idea how that feels?

I tried calling your front desk twice last week and got voicemail both times. Nobody called back. I sent a portal message on April 30 and never got a reply. At this point I genuinely do not know if my case is still open or if you all forgot about me.

I need a real answer. Not a 'we'll get back to you' answer. A real one. Where is my case, who is working on it, what was the last thing that happened, and what is happening next. I want this in writing by end of week. If I don't hear something substantive I am going to assume you have abandoned the file and I will act accordingly.
